title: Step 4 — confirm the fCeBM landed
description: The payer bank reads its own fCeBM balance: 10,000,000, exactly the deposit. fCeBM is the ERC-20 fiat token on Besu and is NOT what an HTLC locks.
notes: Gateway: Banco de San Jose commercial-bank gateway. No address parameter is accepted or required — a bank can only read the balance of the Besu operator its own gateway is configured with. No decimals count is stated anywhere in the platform for fCeBM or tCeBM: treat the value as an opaque big-integer decimal string and compare deltas, never assume a scale factor.
